version.name: 0.1.1-test
version.author: Davvo
version.changelog: Add per-track Notes with wrapped display, click-to-edit and project persistence. Add draggable numeric fields, faster fade adjustments and consistent right-click defaults. Reduce repeated menu redraws by grouping wheel edits and saving Notes after editing. Improve Channel strip spacing, FX/Sends layout, numeric limits and selection-scoped undo. Improve native meters, fader preference support, FX slot handling and FX search. Remove redundant single-type event captions; retain mixed-selection summaries and tooltips.
